title: OTel collector fixture: retry only the Docker image pull on transient registry failures
answers: tracing tests fail with a Docker Hub connection reset before any test runs
how do I make the OTel collector docker pull retry on flaky network errors
why does the otel_collector fixture fail on docker pull in CI
OTLP collector test setup errors out on transient Docker Hub failure
body:
Symptom: Tracing tests that use the OpenTelemetry collector error out during fixture setup with a Docker Hub connection reset, so none of the tracing tests run.
Root cause: tests/tracing/conftest.py:otel_collector ran `docker pull otel/opentelemetry-collector` once via subprocess.check_call, so any transient registry failure raised CalledProcessError and failed the whole fixture.
Fix pattern: wrap only the pull in a bounded loop of 3 attempts. Break on success, sleep 2 ** (attempt + 1) seconds (2s, then 4s) between failures, and re-raise the last CalledProcessError on the final attempt. Do not swallow the error or redirect Docker's output.
Constraints: the retry covers only `docker pull`; `docker run`, the config write and the readiness wait are not retried by this pattern. Keep the attempt count and backoff bounded so a genuinely broken registry still fails fast.
applies: Applies to the Docker-based otel_collector fixture in tests/tracing/conftest.py and any similar test fixture that shells out to docker pull.
says: Tracing test suite fails during setup due to transient container image download errors
Continuous integration tracing runs abort before starting because the registry connection was reset
Automatically retry downloading the collector image when network failures happen during test initialization
search: The Docker-based otel_collector fixture in tests/tracing/conftest.py must retry only the docker pull otel/opentelemetry-collector step against transient registry failures. The pull is wrapped in a bounded loop of 3 attempts with exponential backoff of 2 and 4 seconds, re-raising CalledProcessError on the final failure without redirecting output. Retries must not cover docker run, config file writes, or readiness waits, ensuring genuinely broken registries fail quickly.
